description: Source code for GTP-U demultiplexer implementation, handling GTP-U PDUs, managing tunnels, and error indications.

classes.name: gtpu_demux_impl
classes.description: Implementation of GTP-U demuxer handling PDUs, tunnels, and error indications.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the demuxer by setting the stopped flag.

methods.name: set_error_indication_tx
methods.description: Configures the transmission of error indications with peer address derived from local address.

methods.name: send_error_indication
methods.description: Sends an error indication message for a specific TEID and source address.

methods.name: add_tunnel
methods.description: Adds a new GTP-U tunnel for a given TEID.

methods.name: remove_tunnel
methods.description: Removes a tunnel associated with a TEID.

methods.name: apply_test_teid
methods.description: Sets a test TEID for testing mode.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming GTP-U PDU, routing or dropping based on tunnel existence.

methods.name: write_pcap
methods.description: Writes PDU to PCAP file if enabled.

methods.name: handle_pdu_impl
methods.description: Forwards PDU to the associated tunnel after processing.
